name: Spotlight Files
author: Thibaud Berdin
description: Spotlight-style file and document search for Omarchy: instant filename fuzzy search (fd + built-in path ranker) and on-demand PDF, Office & text content search (SQLite FTS5 + ripgrep) with live preview, Dropbox share-link copy, and zero background daemon.

barWidget.description: Open Spotlight file and document content search (left-click: names, right-click: content).
